about_the_game:
DLC Includes:

  • The complete “Shadow of WuXia” questline - an immersive experience that uncovers the hidden stories of the martial arts world.

  • New Wuxia-style Arena - Sharpen your skills in life-or-death battles with martial arts heroes from the East.

  • New Martial Arts Skills to Learn - Unlock the dynamic and flowing martial arts styles of the Orient and tease your opponents with your skillful maneuvers.

  • Unlock two genres of martial arts - unlock more diverse combinations and open up a whole new fighting style.

  • Chinese styple Armor Set - Tough and protective, combining ancient oriental charm and combat style.

  • Martial arts suits - oriental attire full of “exotic flavor”!

  • Martial Arts Style Weapons - carefully forged oriental weapons to help you advance in your fighting career!
